hypothesis: After source-only syntax diversification, bounded observation prefixes with retained cleanup may expose smaller complete defect witnesses across all 17 trials. This phase measures construction and native behavior before any semantic gate.
selection: First eight distinct normalized syntax/scope identities per trial in the existing fixed source ranking. Sort chosen parents by selection rank then trial. Identity is an allocation heuristic, not semantic equivalence.
source_pool: 1438 historical controlled failures. Only pool membership and source artifacts participate; native failure text, model decisions and evaluation labels do not.
execution: Try prefix rank round-robin over all parents; stop each parent at its first controlled failure or failed/unavailable source control. Retain original whole-test fallback. Verify complete emitted syntax before each run.
limitations: The pool was already generated and executed historically. This is not a cold end-to-end cost.
No valid-detector count can be inferred from failing tests alone.
All trials remain development-seen. The 17 denominator includes 14 distinct tasks.
Prefix construction and source finalizer recognition remain bounded.
A whole-test semantic gate still needs authorized provider access; this local phase does not bypass it.

initial_partial.error: Two edits start at the same source byte. The emitter explicitly refuses the prefix. The v5 probe aborts instead of recording this refusal.
initial_partial.experiment_validity: The 37 completed programs retain their receipts. No execution occurred for the refused prefix.

continuation.changes: Only recover explicit unsupported-emission records and continue the frozen order. Program bytes, parents, native budget, deadline and semantic stopping rule remain fixed.
continuation.tests: Four focused tests pass. Refusal is recoverable; unexplained failure stays fatal; changed programs cannot reuse outcomes; probe cannot import an alert.

interim_audit.interpretation: The earlier calibration result does not transfer to this source-ranked snapshot. Most first failures retain stale expectations or invalid setup. This is an incomplete construction audit, not detector scoring.

checkpoint_recovery.failure: The first continuation tried to overwrite an immutable parent result on its second prefix. Each outcome had already been persisted.
checkpoint_recovery.repair: Keep one immutable parent snapshot per rank and write the final parent result after the loop. Merge earlier cached receipts when making another continuation.
checkpoint_recovery.tests: Five focused tests pass, including a two-prefix pass-then-fail run that exercises checkpoint persistence.
checkpoint_recovery.scope: Only checkpoint handling changes. Same candidate bytes, cohort, order, stop policy, budget and deadline.
